Class PixelPainter

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.plugin.PluginBase
org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin
dev.despical.pixelpainter.PixelPainter
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.papermc.paper.plugin.lifecycle.event.LifecycleEventOwner, net.kyori.adventure.key.Namespaced, org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor, org.bukkit.command.TabCompleter, org.bukkit.command.TabExecutor, org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin
public final class PixelPainter extends org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin
Starts PixelPainter and connects its configuration, commands and painting services.

The entry point owns service lifetimes rather than loading YAML or managing worker queues itself. ConfigurationManager creates and validates resources; TaskExecutor handles blocking image/file work and server-thread callbacks; PaintService owns world jobs, chunk tickets and persistent recovery history.

Startup proceeds in that order so commands cannot observe missing resources or unrecovered journals. Any initialization failure disables the plugin. Shutdown releases world resources before closing the worker executor, leaving completed undo journals available for recovery on the next startup.
